notes: «سمعت أبي يحدث» names no one: the father is a bare relation (rule 7)
«ابن أخي، صفوان بن محرز» describes Khalid as Safwan's nephew; Safwan is a link only at «حدث عن صفوان بن محرز» (occurrence 2)
Jundab is the last link: his speech «إني أتيتكم» is the saying (rule 6); عسعس is an addressee, not a link
«وكنا نحدث أنه أسامة بن زيد» is a remark in the story, not a transmitter
